密码须为 12–128 个字符，且不能全为空白；首尾空格会保留。: Use 12–128 characters, not only whitespace. Leading and trailing spaces are preserved.
两次输入的新密码不一致。: The new passwords do not match.
请妥善保存，不要分享或截图。: Store securely. Do not share or take screenshots.
新恢复密钥替代旧密钥。它仅用于设密或重置密码，不能登录或接入商城。: This new recovery key replaces the old key. It is only for password setup or reset, not login or store integration.
API 凭据独立于登录密码；密码重置不会影响 API 凭据。: API credentials are separate from your login password. Password resets do not affect them.
无法复制，请手动选择并保存。: Copy failed. Select and save it manually.
修改后所有浏览器会话都会退出，请用新密码重新登录。: Changing your password logs out all browser sessions. Log in again with the new password.
验证成功后仅在此弹窗临时显示，关闭即清空。: After verification, the credential is shown temporarily in this dialog only and cleared when closed.
后台未返回凭据，请重试。: The server did not return a credential. Please try again.
密码或恢复密钥不正确，或登录已失效，请核对后重试。: The password or recovery key is incorrect, or your session has expired. Check and retry.
登录已失效，请重新输入密码。: Your session has expired. Log in again with your password.
此操作需要密码登录会话，请重新登录。: This action requires a password login session. Please log in again.
尚未设置登录密码，请使用现有恢复密钥首次设密。: No login password is set. Use your existing recovery key to set one up.
正在处理另一项身份操作，请稍后重试。: Another authentication operation is in progress. Please try again shortly.
请在钱包中授权账户并核对网络。: Authorize the account in your wallet and check the network.
钱包配置与查询目标链不符。: The wallet configuration does not match the target chain for this query.
错链找回必须使用目标部署固定收款 payout 钱包签名。: Wrong-chain recovery must be signed by the fixed payout wallet for the target deployment.
没有可归集余额，没有发送交易。: No balance is available to sweep. No transaction was sent.
审核摘要与目标部署不符，已阻止发送。: The review summary does not match the target deployment. Sending has been blocked.
此记录有未完成的发送尝试，请在恢复页登记原交易，不能再次发送。: This record has an unresolved send attempt. Register the original transaction on the recovery page. Do not send again.
交易数据与审核摘要不同，已阻止发送。: The transaction data does not match the review summary. Sending has been blocked.
只有点击下方按钮，才会交给钱包发送一次。: The transaction will be passed to your wallet for a single send attempt only when you click the button below.
准备同地址部署入口（不会注册商户部署）: Prepare the same-address deployment entry point (does not register a merchant deployment)
必须使用固定收款 payout 钱包；不能签名的地址不支持: The fixed payout wallet is required. Addresses that cannot sign are not supported.
关闭页面或断网不会取消已签名交易: Closing this page or losing connectivity will not cancel a signed transaction
后台会先持久记录 UNKNOWN，再交给钱包；任何不确定结果都只能恢复原交易，不: The backend first persists the transaction as UNKNOWN, then passes it to the wallet. If the outcome is uncertain, only the original transaction may be recovered; it must not be resent automatically.
请在钱包中核对并确认: Review and confirm in your wallet
结果未知时请勿重新发起，原记录会保留用于恢复。: Do not initiate another transaction while the outcome is unknown. The original record will be retained for recovery.
交易已核验上链，请查看逐笔结果: The transaction has been verified on-chain. Check the individual results.
已登记原交易哈希，等待后台链上核验。: The original transaction hash has been registered. Awaiting on-chain verification by the backend.
请到归集异常恢复或部署记录核对。不会自动重新发送。: Check Sweep Recovery or Deployment Records. The transaction will not be resent automatically.
未自动发送或重发交易；如已有准备记录，请在记录页查看。: No transaction was sent or resent automatically. If a preparation record exists, check it on the records page.
原交易登记已完成，未发送新交易。: The original transaction has been registered. No new transaction was sent.
重试登记本机原哈希: Retry registering original hash stored on this device
重试登记本机明确拒签: Retry registering explicit signature rejection on this device
该部署当前无法加载: This deployment cannot be loaded right now
服务端保留了它的历史数据，但启动时读取失败。请检查服务端日志后重启服务；其他部署: The server has retained this deployment's historical data but could not read it at startup. Check the server logs, then restart the service. Other deployments are not affected.
本次交易已经开始，请恢复原交易，不要重发。: This transaction has already started. Recover the original transaction; do not resend it.
后台没有返回持久 UNKNOWN 交易，已阻止发送。: The backend did not return a persisted UNKNOWN transaction. Sending has been blocked.
钱包未返回有效哈希；请查找原交易，不能重发。: The wallet did not return a valid hash. Locate the original transaction; do not resend it.
只交给本次操作的人。: Share only with the person performing this operation.
网络 Chain ID 无效。: The network Chain ID is invalid.
钱包网络需要不含用户名密码的 HTTPS RPC。: The wallet network requires an HTTPS RPC URL without a username or password.
请先设置该链正确的 gas 原生币符号。: First set the correct symbol for the chain's native gas token.
目标部署尚未核验。: The target deployment has not been verified.
钱包正在连接，请先完成或取消。: A wallet connection is in progress. Complete or cancel it first.
请在设置中保存你自己的 Reown Project ID；浏览器钱包无需此 ID: Save your own Reown Project ID in Settings. Browser wallets do not require this ID.
未检测到浏览器钱包扩展，请安装兼容 EIP-1193 的钱包。: No browser wallet extension detected. Install an EIP-1193-compatible wallet.
钱包账户或网络不正确。: The wallet account or network is incorrect.
钱包账户或网络已改变，请重新核对；不会自动重发。: The wallet account or network has changed. Review it again. The transaction will not be resent automatically.
钱包账户或网络已改变；不会自动重发。: The wallet account or network has changed. The transaction will not be resent automatically.
交易网络、账户、合约、金额或字段与审核范围不符，已阻止发送。: The transaction network, account, contract, amount, or fields do not match what was reviewed. Sending has been blocked.
钱包会话已改变，禁止发送。: The wallet session has changed. Sending is prohibited.
同地址部署必须由固定收款 payout 钱包签名；不能签名的收款地址不支持此模式: Same-address deployment must be signed by the fixed payout wallet. Payout addresses that cannot sign do not support this mode.
该网络尚未开放：官方 EIP-2470 入口缺失或代码不符，请联系运营方。: This network is not yet available: the official EIP-2470 entry point is missing or its code does not match. Contact the operator.
该网络尚未开放：公共入口未就绪，请联系运营方完成部署。客户端只能部署商户合约。: This network is not yet available: the public entry point is not ready. Contact the operator to complete its deployment. The client can only deploy merchant contracts.
部署交易网络、账户、金额或字段与审核范围不符，已阻止发送。: The deployment transaction network, account, amount, or fields do not match what was reviewed. Sending has been blocked.
确定性部署目标与认证入口不符。: The deterministic deployment target does not match the authenticated entry point.
确定性部署交易与后台持久 intent 不符。: The deterministic deployment transaction does not match the intent persisted by the backend.
公共入口代码、salt 或预期地址与审核摘要不符。: The public entry point code, salt, or expected address does not match the review summary.
商户部署数据与收款钱包、币种摘要不符。: The merchant deployment data does not match the payout wallet and token summary.
部署数据与审核摘要不符。: The deployment data does not match the review summary.
当前部署或目标链配置已改变，请关闭后重新查询；禁止发送。: The current deployment or target chain configuration has changed. Close this view and run the query again. Sending is prohibited.
错链找回查询结果与原订单、目标链或收款钱包不符，已阻止继续。: The wrong-chain recovery query results do not match the original order, target chain, or payout wallet. Further action has been blocked.
找回任务不属于已核对的目标链和资产，已阻止发送。: The recovery task does not match the reviewed target chain and asset. Sending has been blocked.
尚未检测到选定币种的付款。: No payment in the selected token has been detected yet.
有效期内已到账但不足应付金额。: Payment was received before expiry, but the amount is less than the amount due.
到账金额已足够，等待达到配置的确认数。: The amount received is sufficient. Waiting for the configured number of confirmations.
有效期内已确认金额等于应付金额。: The amount confirmed before expiry equals the amount due.
已确认金额超过应付金额，归集时会一并转入固定收款地址。: The confirmed amount exceeds the amount due. The excess will also be transferred to the fixed payout address during the sweep.
有效期内未付足。: Not paid in full before expiry.
有到账发生在有效期之后，不计入订单付款，请人工核实。: Funds received after expiry do not count toward the order payment. Manual verification is required.
入口就绪 · 待部署商户: Entry point ready · Merchant deployment pending
该网络尚未开放新建商户部署，请选择已开放网络；旧部署导入和已有任务恢复不受影响。: New merchant deployments are not yet available on this network. Choose an available network. Importing legacy deployments and recovering existing tasks are not affected.
该网络尚未开放：官方 ERC-2470 入口不可用，请联系运营方。: This network is not yet available: the official ERC-2470 entry point is unavailable. Contact the operator.
公共入口仅允许运营方通过独立工具部署，客户端不能新建此任务。: Only the operator can deploy the public entry point using a separate tool. The client cannot create this task.
该网络尚未开放：公共入口未就绪，请联系运营方。: This network is not yet available: the public entry point is not ready. Contact the operator.
尝试次数过多，请 5 分钟后再试。: Too many attempts. Try again in 5 minutes.
请求来源不正确，请从后台页面直接操作。: Invalid request origin. Perform this operation directly from the admin page.
后台正在处理另一项操作，请稍后重试。: The backend is processing another operation. Try again later.
链上记录还在追赶，同步完成后才能归集。: On-chain records are still catching up. Sweeping is only available after synchronization completes.
链上区块发生变化，请稍后重试。: The on-chain blocks have changed. Try again later.
本次选中的订单仍有未处理交易，请先恢复这些订单；其他订单可以正常归集。: The selected orders still have unresolved transactions. Recover these orders first. Other orders can be swept as usual.
任务状态已变化，请刷新后重新核对。: The task status has changed. Refresh and review it again.
钱包没有足够的原生币支付 gas。: The wallet does not have enough native tokens to pay for gas.
当前部署任务不能重新唤起钱包，请刷新并核对原交易。: The wallet cannot be reopened for this deployment task. Refresh and check the original transaction.
重新唤签仅支持原手机部署入口。: Reopening the signing request is only supported through the original mobile deployment entry point.
部署参数发生变化，已停止重新唤签。: The deployment parameters have changed. Reopening the signing request has been stopped.
旧版新建部署已停用，请使用跨链同址新版；已有旧合约可从高级入口导入和管理。: Creating legacy deployments is disabled. Use the new cross-chain same-address mode. Existing legacy contracts can be imported and managed through the advanced options.
名称不能为空，且不能超过 128 个字符；只能修改显示名称。: The name is required and must not exceed 128 characters. Only the display name can be changed.
找不到该部署，请刷新部署列表。: Deployment not found. Refresh the deployment list.
该部署当前无法加载，请检查服务端日志。: This deployment cannot be loaded right now. Check the server logs.
请求中的部署与当前选择不一致，已拒绝。: The deployment in the request does not match the current selection. The request has been rejected.
已有部署不能修改配置；请通过“添加链”创建新部署。: The configuration of an existing deployment cannot be changed. Use “Add chain” to create a new deployment.
新模式必须用固定收款钱包确认商户部署或恢复，请切换到该钱包。: The new mode requires the fixed payout wallet to confirm merchant deployment or recovery. Switch to that wallet.
这条链没有经过核验的标准部署入口，暂不能使用跨链同地址模式；可以选择旧模式。: This chain has no verified standard deployment entry point, so cross-chain same-address mode is not yet available. You can choose legacy mode.
标准部署入口的代码与固定版本不符，已阻止操作。: The standard deployment entry point code does not match the pinned version. The operation has been blocked.
这个商户地址已完成部署，无需再次发送。请取消当前未发送任务，再用原参数核对并导入: This merchant address is already deployed. No further transaction is needed. Cancel the current unsent task, then use the original parameters to verify and import the existing deployment.
公共部署入口的代码不符，已阻止操作。: The public deployment entry point code does not match. The operation has been blocked.
本地合约与固定版本清单不一致，已停止生成地址；请核对版本，不要盲目重新部署。: The local contracts do not match the pinned version manifest. Address generation has been stopped. Check the versions; do not redeploy without verification.
公共入口部署预演未成功，尚未请求钱包发送交易，请核对链和入口状态。: The public entry point deployment simulation was unsuccessful. The wallet has not been asked to send a transaction. Check the chain and entry point status.
该地址的固定币种名单与填写的不一致，不能覆盖；请核对原配置或选择旧模式另建部署。: The fixed token list for this address does not match your input and cannot be overwritten. Check the original configuration or use legacy mode to create a separate deployment.
源链与目标链都必须是已核验的新同地址模式；旧地址不能自动升级恢复。: Both the source and target chains must use the verified new same-address mode. Legacy addresses cannot be automatically upgraded for recovery.
请选择另一条实际到账链，同链错币请使用现有错币归集。: Select the other chain where the funds actually arrived. For a wrong token on the same chain, use the existing wrong-token sweep.
两条链的收款钱包、Factory 或版本不一致，已阻止恢复。: The payout wallet, Factory, or version differs between the two chains. Recovery has been blocked.
原订单在目标链的预测地址不一致，已阻止操作；请勿重建订单代替。: The original order's predicted address on the target chain does not match. The operation has been blocked. Do not recreate the order as a workaround.
原订单不属于所选源链部署，已阻止操作。: The original order does not belong to the selected source-chain deployment. The operation has been blocked.
指定资产在目标链的原订单地址暂无可归集余额，请核对网络和 CA。: The specified asset has no balance available to sweep at the original order address on the target chain. Check the network and CA.
区块重组后确认数不足，已退回等待确认，不要重复发送。: There are insufficient confirmations after a block reorganization. The transaction is awaiting confirmations again. Do not send it again.
RPC 必须是 HTTPS 地址。: The RPC URL must use HTTPS.
RPC 地址中不能包含用户名或密码。: The RPC URL must not contain a username or password.
RPC 返回的 Chain ID 与填写的不一致。: The Chain ID returned by the RPC does not match your input.
有代币地址在该链上不是合约，请核对 CA。: One or more token addresses are not contracts on this chain. Check the CA.
收款地址无效，或与代币地址相同。: The payout address is invalid or matches a token address.
交易哈希格式不正确（0x 加 64 位十六进制）。: Invalid transaction hash format (0x followed by 64 hexadecimal characters).
该哈希与这笔任务不匹配（发送者、合约、调用数据或网络不同）。: This hash does not match the task (the sender, contract, calldata, or network differs).
这条记录已登记过另一个哈希。: A different hash is already registered for this record.
该哈希已被另一条记录使用。: This hash is already used by another record.
该哈希不是这条部署记录发出的创建交易。: This hash is not the contract creation transaction initiated by this deployment record.
这条部署记录已有交易哈希，不能登记为拒签。: This deployment record already has a transaction hash and cannot be registered as a signature rejection.
结果未知的交易不能直接取消，请先登记原哈希或按流程结案。: A transaction with an unknown outcome cannot be canceled directly. Register the original hash first or follow the manual resolution process.
需要勾选风险确认并填写至少 4 个字的说明。: Acknowledge the risks and enter an explanation of at least 4 characters.
这笔任务已有交易哈希，只能通过链上核对结案。: This task already has a transaction hash. Resolution requires on-chain verification.
只有待发送或失败的通知可以重新排队。: Only pending or failed webhooks can be requeued.
已有一个手机入口正在开放，请先处理或关闭。: A mobile access entry point is already being opened. Complete or close it first.
指定的 cloudflared 无法运行，请检查路径和执行权限。: The configured cloudflared executable cannot run. Check its path and execution permissions.
手机入口组件下载失败，请检查运行设备的网络后重试。: The mobile access component could not be downloaded. Check the network on the device running UPayNow and retry.
手机入口组件校验失败，未执行下载文件，请重试。: The mobile access component failed integrity verification. The downloaded file was not executed. Please retry.
无法保存手机入口组件，请检查数据目录的写入权限和磁盘空间。: The mobile access component could not be saved. Check write permissions and free disk space for the data directory.
当前系统或处理器暂不支持自动下载 cloudflared，请手动指定兼容组件。: Automatic cloudflared download is not supported on this system or processor. Configure a compatible executable manually.
请先在“链与合约”中配置收款部署，再执行链上操作。: Configure a payment deployment under Chains & Contracts before performing on-chain operations.
临时手机入口启动超时，没有自动重试。: The temporary mobile access entry point timed out during startup. No automatic retry was attempted.
临时手机入口启动失败。: The temporary mobile access entry point failed to start.
所选订单当前没有可归集余额。: The selected orders currently have no balance available to sweep.
这个商户订单号已用于不同的金额、币种或通知设置。: This merchant order ID has already been used with a different amount, token, or webhook configuration.
该代币不在当前部署的支持列表中。: This token is not in the current deployment's supported list.
金额需为十进制数字，例如 10.50。: The amount must be a decimal number, such as 10.50.
金额小数位超过该代币支持的精度。: The amount has more decimal places than this token supports.
通知地址的域名不在服务器允许列表中。: The webhook URL's domain is not on the server's allowlist.
后台或链上节点暂时不可用。: The backend or blockchain node is temporarily unavailable.
无法连接后台，请检查网络。: Unable to connect to the backend. Check your network connection.
后台响应超时。若已开始钱包操作，请先核对原任务，不要重复发送。: The backend response timed out. If you have already started a wallet operation, check the original task first. Do not send again.
后台返回了无法识别的数据，请检查服务状态。: The backend returned unrecognized data. Check the service status.
